name: Bai Ze
source_book: Yunji Qiqian: Annals of the Yellow Emperor
original_text: 帝巡狩，东至海，登桓山，于海滨得白泽神兽，能言，达于万物之情。
translation: The Yellow Emperor toured east to the sea and climbed Mount Huan. On the shore he found the sacred beast Baize, which could speak and knew the nature of all things.

name: Bashe
original_text: 巴蛇食象，三岁而出其骨，君子服之，无心腹之疾。其为蛇青黄赤黑。
translation: The Ba serpent swallows elephants and spits out the bones after three years. A gentleman who takes them suffers no ills of heart or belly. The serpent is blue, yellow, red and black.

name: Bifang
original_text: 有鸟焉，其状如鹤，一足，赤文青质而白喙，名曰毕方，其鸣自叫也，见则其邑有讹火。
translation: A bird lives here, like a crane with one leg, red markings on blue, and a white beak. It is called the Bifang and cries its own name. When it appears, strange fires break out in its town.

name: Biyi Bird
original_text: 比翼鸟在其东，其为鸟青、赤，两鸟比翼。一曰在南山东。
translation: The Biyi birds live to its east. They are green and red; two birds fly wing to wing. Some say they live east of the Southern Mountain.

name: Bo
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如马而白身黑尾，一角，虎牙爪，音如鼓音，其名曰駮，是食虎豹，可以御兵。
translation: A beast lives here, like a white horse with a black tail, one horn, and a tiger's teeth and claws. Its voice is like a drum. It is called the Bo. It eats tigers and leopards, and wards off war.

name: Boyi
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如羊，九尾四耳，其目在背，其名曰猼訑，佩之不畏。
translation: A beast lives here, like a goat with nine tails, four ears, and eyes on its back. It is called the Boyi. Wearing it frees one from fear.

name: Chenghuang
original_text: 白民之国在龙鱼北，白身被发。有乘黄，其状如狐，其背上有角，乘之寿二千岁。
translation: The land of the Baimin lies north of the Dragon Fish; its people are white with loose hair. There is the Chenghuang, like a fox with horns on its back. Whoever rides it lives 2,000 years.

name: Chiru
original_text: 英水出焉，南流注于即翼之泽。其中多赤鱬，其状如鱼而人面，其音如鸳鸯，食之不疥。
translation: The Ying River rises here and flows south into the Jiyi Marsh. In it are many Chiru, shaped like fish with human faces. They sound like mandarin ducks. Whoever eats one never gets scabies.

name: Dangkang
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如豚而有牙，其名曰当康，其鸣自叫，见则天下大穰。
translation: A beast lives here, like a pig with tusks, called the Dangkang. It cries its own name. When it appears, the whole world reaps a great harvest.

name: Fei
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如牛而白首，一目而蛇尾，其名曰蜚，行水则竭，行草则死，见则天下大疫。
translation: A beast lives here, like an ox with a white head, one eye and a snake's tail. It is called the Fei. Water it crosses dries up, grass it crosses dies. When it appears, great plague sweeps the land.

name: Feiyi
original_text: 削成而四方，其高五千仞，其广十里，鸟兽莫居。有蛇焉，名曰肥遗，六足四翼，见则天下大旱。
translation: The mountain is cut square, 5,000 ren high and 10 li wide; no bird or beast lives there. There is a snake called the Feiyi with six legs and four wings. When it appears, great drought strikes the land.

name: Fenghuang
original_text: 有鸟焉，其状如鸡，五采而文，名曰凤皇，首文曰德，翼文曰义，背文曰礼，膺文曰仁，腹文曰信。是鸟也，饮食自然，自歌自舞，见则天下安宁。
translation: A bird lives here, like a rooster, five-colored and patterned, called the Fenghuang. The marks on its head read Virtue, on its wings Duty, on its back Rite, on its breast Kindness, on its belly Trust. It eats and drinks as it pleases, and sings and dances by itself. When it appears, the world is at peace.

name: Gudiao
original_text: 水有兽焉，名曰蛊雕，其状如雕而有角，其音如婴儿之音，是食人。
translation: In the water lives a beast called the Gudiao, like an eagle with a horn, crying like a baby. It eats people.

name: Heluoyu
original_text: 其中多何罗之鱼，一首而十身，其音如吠犬，食之已痈。
translation: In it are many Heluo fish, each with one head and ten bodies. They bark like dogs. Eating one cures boils.

name: Huashe
original_text: 阳水出焉，而北流注于伊水。其中多化蛇，其状如人面而豺身，鸟翼而蛇行，其音如叱呼，见则其邑大水。
translation: The Yang River flows from here north into the Yi. In it live many Huashe: a human face on a jackal's body, bird wings, moving like a snake, with a cry like a shout. When one appears, its town floods.

name: Hundun
original_text: 有神焉，其状如黄囊，赤如丹火，六足四翼，浑敦无面目，是识歌舞，实为帝江也。
translation: A god lives here, shaped like a yellow sack, red as cinnabar fire, with six legs and four wings. It is a faceless blur, yet it knows song and dance. It is Dijiang.

name: Jiaochong
original_text: 有神焉，其状如人而二首，名曰骄虫，是为螫虫，实惟蜂蜜之庐。
translation: A god lives here, like a man with two heads, called Jiaochong. He is lord of the stinging insects; this is the home of bees.

name: Jingwei
original_text: 有鸟焉，其状如乌，文首，白喙，赤足，名曰精卫，其鸣自詨。是炎帝之少女，名曰女娃。女娃游于东海，溺而不返，故为精卫，常衔西山之木石，以堙于东海。
translation: A bird lives here, like a crow with a patterned head, white beak and red feet. It is called the Jingwei and cries its own name. She was Wa, youngest daughter of the Flame Emperor, who drowned in the Eastern Sea. Now she carries twigs and stones from the western hills to fill it.

name: Jufu
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如禺而文臂，豹虎而善投，名曰举父。
translation: A beast lives here, like a monkey with striped arms, like a leopard or tiger, and a fine thrower. It is called the Jufu.

name: Kui
original_text: 其上有兽，状如牛，苍身而无角，一足，出入水则必风雨，其光如日月，其声如雷，其名曰夔。黄帝得之，以其皮为鼓，橛以雷兽之骨，声闻五百里，以威天下。
translation: On the mountain lives a beast like an ox, gray, hornless and one-legged. Wind and rain follow whenever it enters the water; it shines like the sun and moon and roars like thunder. It is called the Kui. The Yellow Emperor made a drum of its hide, beat it with a thunder-beast's bone, and it was heard 500 li away, awing the world.

name: Lili
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如豚，有距，其音如狗吠，其名曰狸力，见则其县多土功。
translation: A beast lives here, like a pig with spurs, barking like a dog. It is called the Lili. Where it appears, the county sees great earthworks.

name: Lu Wu
original_text: 是实惟帝之下都，神陆吾司之。其神状虎身而九尾，人面而虎爪；是神也，司天之九部及帝之囿时。
translation: This is truly the Heavenly Emperor's capital on earth, and the god Luwu keeps it. He has a tiger's body with nine tails, a human face and tiger claws, and keeps the nine realms of heaven and the seasons of the Emperor's gardens.

name: Luoyu
original_text: 濛水出焉，南流注于洋水，其中多黄贝；蠃鱼，鱼身而鸟翼，音如鸳鸯，见则其邑大水。
translation: The Meng River rises here and flows south into the Yang. In it are many yellow cowries, and Luo fish with fish bodies and bird wings. They sound like mandarin ducks. When one appears, its town floods.

name: Lushu
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如马而白首，其文如虎而赤尾，其音如谣，其名曰鹿蜀，佩之宜子孙。
translation: A beast lives here, like a horse with a white head, striped like a tiger, with a red tail. Its voice is like singing. It is called the Lushu. Wearing it blesses one with many descendants.

name: Mafu
original_text: 伊水出焉，而东流注于洛。有兽焉，其名曰马腹，其状如人面虎身，其音如婴儿，是食人。
translation: The Yi River flows from here east into the Luo. A beast lives here called the Mafu: a human face on a tiger's body, a cry like a baby's. It eats people.

name: Mengji
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如豹，而文题白身，名曰孟极，是善伏，其鸣自呼。
translation: A beast lives here like a leopard, with a patterned brow and a white body. It is called the Mengji. It is good at lying in wait, and its cry calls its own name.

name: Nine-Tailed Fox
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如狐而九尾，其音如婴儿，能食人，食者不蛊。
translation: A beast lives here, like a fox with nine tails and a cry like a baby's. It eats people. Whoever eats it is safe from curses.

name: Qinggeng
original_text: 有鸟焉，其状如鹊，青身白喙，白目白尾，名曰青耕，可以御疫，其鸣自叫。
translation: A bird lives here, like a magpie, with a blue body, a white beak, white eyes and a white tail. It is called the Qinggeng. It wards off plague and cries its own name.

name: Qinyuan
original_text: 有鸟焉，其状如蜂，大如鸳鸯，名曰钦原，蠚鸟兽则死，蠚木则枯。
translation: There is a bird like a bee, as big as a mandarin duck, called the Qinyuan. Whatever bird or beast it stings dies; whatever tree it stings withers.

name: Qiongqi
original_text: 其上有兽焉，其状如牛，猬毛，名曰穷奇，音如獆狗，是食人。
translation: On it lives a beast like an ox with hedgehog bristles, called the Qiongqi. It howls like a hound and eats people.

name: Taotie
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如羊身人面，其目在腋下，虎齿人爪，其音如婴儿，名曰狍鸮，是食人。（郭璞注：为物贪惏，食人未尽，还害其身，像在夏鼎，《左传》所谓饕餮是也。）
translation: A beast lives here, with a goat's body and human face, eyes under its armpits, tiger teeth and human nails, crying like a baby. It is called the Paoxiao and eats people. (Guo Pu's note: so greedy it eats people and, not yet full, harms itself. It is cast on the Xia cauldrons: the Taotie of the Zuo Zhuan.)

name: Tiangou
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如狸而白首，名曰天狗，其音如榴榴，可以御凶。
translation: A beast lives here, like a wildcat with a white head, called the Tiangou. Its cry goes "liu-liu", and it wards off evil.

name: Tianwu
original_text: 朝阳之谷，神曰天吴，是为水伯。……其为兽也，八首人面，八足八尾，背青黄。
translation: In Zhaoyang Valley is the god Tianwu, who rules the waters. … As a beast, it has eight heads with human faces, eight legs, eight tails, and a back of blue and yellow.

name: Tulou
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如羊而四角，名曰土蝼，是食人。
translation: A beast lives here, like a ram with four horns, called the Tulou. It eats people.

name: Xingxing
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如禺而白耳，伏行人走，其名曰狌狌，食之善走。
translation: A beast lives here, like a monkey with white ears. It goes on all fours, or runs upright like a man. It is called the Xingxing. Whoever eats it becomes swift of foot.

name: Xiqu
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如牛，苍身，其音如婴儿，是食人，其名曰犀渠。
translation: A beast lives here like an ox, azure-bodied, with a cry like a baby's. It eats people. It is called the Xiqu.

name: Xuangui
original_text: 怪水出焉，而东流注于宪翼之水。其中多玄龟，其状如龟而鸟首虺尾，其名曰旋龟，其音如判木，佩之不聋，可以为底。
translation: The Guai River rises here and flows east into the Xianyi. In it are many dark turtles, shaped like turtles with bird heads and viper tails, called the Xuangui. Their voice is like splitting wood. Wearing one keeps away deafness and cures calluses.

name: Yinglong
original_text: 大荒东北隅中，有山名曰凶犁土丘。应龙出南极，杀蚩尤与夸父，不得复上。故下数旱，旱而为应龙之状，乃得大雨。
translation: In the northeast corner of the Great Wilds is a mountain called Xiongli Earth Hill. Yinglong dwells at the southern pole: it slew Chiyou and Kuafu and could not rise to heaven again. So the land below often suffers drought; in drought, people make Yinglong's likeness, and great rains come.

name: Yufu
original_text: 有鱼偏枯，名曰鱼妇。颛顼死即复苏。风道北来，天乃大水泉，蛇乃化为鱼，是为鱼妇。颛顼死即复苏。
translation: There is a fish withered on one side, called the Yufu. When Zhuanxu died, he came back to life. A wind blew from the north, the heavens poured forth great springs, and snakes turned into fish: this is the Yufu. When Zhuanxu died, he came back to life.

name: Zheng
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如赤豹，五尾一角，其音如击石，其名如狰。
translation: A beast lives here, like a red leopard with five tails and one horn. Its cry is like striking stone. It is called the Zheng.

name: Zhulong
original_text: 有神，人面蛇身而赤，直目正乘，其瞑乃晦，其视乃明，不食不寝不息，风雨是谒。是烛九阴，是谓烛龙。
translation: There is a god, red, with a human face on a snake's body and upright eyes. When it shuts its eyes the world goes dark; when it opens them it is light. It neither eats, sleeps nor breathes, and summons wind and rain. It lights the nine darks: this is the Torch Dragon.

name: Zhuru
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如狐而鱼翼，其名曰朱獳，其鸣自訆，见则其国有恐。
translation: A beast lives here, like a fox with fish fins, called the Zhuru. It cries its own name. When it appears, its land is gripped by fear.

name: Zhuyan
original_text: 有兽焉，其状如猿，而白首赤足，名曰朱厌，见则大兵。
translation: A beast lives here, like an ape with a white head and red feet, called the Zhuyan. When it appears, great wars follow.
